title: Cold Wheels
message: Only wash wheels when they are cool to prevent chemical staining.

title: Air Vents
message: Clean air vents with a soft brush before vacuuming for best results.

title: Top to Bottom
message: Always wash your car from top to bottom to avoid streaks and dirt runoff.

title: Door Seals
message: In winter, dry door seals after washing to prevent them from freezing shut.

title: Microfiber Only
message: Use microfiber towels for drying to avoid swirl marks and scratches.

title: UV Protection
message: Apply UV protectant to your dashboard to prevent plastic from cracking.

title: Glass Clarity
message: Clean inside glass horizontally and outside vertically to spot streaks easily.

title: Wax Check
message: If water stops beading on the hood, it's time to reapply a coat of wax.
